parameters.name: BackgroundResourceId
parameters.description: VOD resource ID of the background material, obtained from the VOD console.

parameters.name: BackgroundResourceUrl
parameters.description: Resource access URL of the background material.

parameters.name: BackgroundType
parameters.description:
Background material type:
- VOD: Video on demand
- PIC: Image
- LIVE: Live stream

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description:
Preview screen height, unit: px.

The preview screen width x height only supports the following specifications:

- Landscape Smooth 360P 640x360
- Portrait Smooth 360P 360x640
- Landscape Standard Definition 480P 854x480
- Portrait Standard Definition 480P 480x854
- Landscape HD 720P 1280x720
- Portrait HD 720P 720x1280
- Landscape Full HD 1080P 1920x1080
- Portrait Full HD 1080P 1080x1920

parameters.name: MattingLayout
parameters.description: Layout position information of the source stream after matting.

parameters.name: MattingType
parameters.description:
Matting type:
- green: Green screen matting
- blue: Blue screen matting
- complex: Real-scene matting

parameters.name: MediaLayout
parameters.description: Layout position information of the multimedia material.

parameters.name: MediaResourceId
parameters.description: VOD resource ID of the multimedia material, obtained from the VOD console.

parameters.name: MediaResourceUrl
parameters.description: Resource access URL of the multimedia material. Either this or the resource ID should be provided.

parameters.name: MediaType
parameters.description:
Multimedia material type:
- VOD: Video on demand
- PIC: Image
- LIVE: Live stream

parameters.name: StudioName
parameters.description: Virtual studio template name, same as the StudioName parameter in the create API.
